# agency-agents (vendored, unmodified, MIT)

12 role playbooks copied unchanged from github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents (MIT, Copyright its authors; commit in `UPSTREAM_COMMIT`), reel 30 Oct 2026.
The n8n Task Runner gives each Kalpa agent its playbook first (`read_kalpa_file`), then Kalpa's own rules win where they differ (free tools, TRAI/DPDP/ASCI/SEBI, honesty, no invented facts).

| Kalpa agent | Playbook |
|---|---|
| Scout | product/product-trend-researcher.md |
| Kavi | marketing/marketing-content-creator.md |
| Adi | sales/sales-offer-lead-gen-strategist.md |
| Lens | design/design-brand-guardian.md |
| Forge | engineering/engineering-backend-architect.md |
| Vigil | testing/testing-reality-checker.md |
| Guard | support/support-legal-compliance-checker.md |
| Deal | marketing/marketing-growth-hacker.md |
| Echo | research/research-synthesist.md |
| Kalpa | specialized/specialized-chief-of-staff.md |
| Customer | product/product-feedback-synthesizer.md |
| Competitor Watch | specialized/business-strategist.md |

The other ~320 playbooks (game dev, healthcare, China platforms…) are not vendored: add one only when a Kalpa world needs it.
